title: DEFROSTER GRILLE, DUCT & CABLES
summary: Windshield defroster (all models): the defroster duct runs from the heater box up to the defroster grille (the slotted vent on top of the dash, at the base of the windshield). The duct is screwed to the dash structure, the grille is screwed up from below into the instrument panel top (View A), and the heater control cables clip onto the heater-box door levers with a push-on nut and have their housings clamped by a screw (View B).

parts.name: NUT
parts.name_expanded: Nut – push-on retainer, cable end to lever stud

fastening.to: dash / heater structure under the instrument panel
fastening.note: Screw assembly [1] goes through the side tab of the defroster duct [2] (main view); the duct's upper end sits under the grille [5] opening.
View A: screws [6] go up from below through the grille [5] end tabs into the dash top under the instrument panel pad (4 tab positions shown with dashed lines).
View B: the cable asm. wire end goes over the stud on the door lever and is held by push-on nut [3]. The lever carries its own stud; there is no separate stud part.
View B: screw [4] clamps the cable asm. housing (sheath) clip to the bracket on the heater case.
